question: A can finish a work in 15 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days can they finish it?
question_ne: A ले एउटा काम १५ दिनमा र B ले ३० दिनमा सक्न सक्छन्। सँगै काम गर्दा कति दिनमा सकिन्छ?
explanation: Together in one day they do 1/15 + 1/30 = 45/450 of the work, so they finish in 10 days.
explanation_ne: सँगै एक दिनमा उनीहरूले १/१५ + १/३० = ४५/४५० भाग गर्छन्, त्यसैले १० दिनमा सकिन्छ।
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

explanation: Father is now 15 x 3 = 45 years; after 10 years he will be 55.
explanation_ne: बुबा अहिले १५ × ३ = ४५ वर्षका छन्; १० वर्षपछि उनी ५५ वर्षका हुनेछन्।
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
